meta.name: DiligenceIQ Databook Ontology

namespaces.fin: Financial statements (P&L, BS, CF, equity, fixed assets)

conventions: One fact = one concept, one value, one period, one basis, one set of dimension members, one unit, one source location.
Expenses, costs and cash outflows are stored as positive magnitudes; calculation weights carry the sign. Concepts flagged signed=true carry their own sign.
Revenue, cost and KPI splits are dimension members on the parent concept, never new concepts (revenue[service_line=<member>]).
Derived metrics (drv.*) are computed by the calculation engine from stored facts; an extracted ratio is kept only as a comparative.
EBITDA always carries view = REPORTED | MANAGEMENT | ADVISER | DILIGENCE | PRO_FORMA; bridges between views are QoE adjustment records.
Nothing in the ontology names a company, file, sheet or deal figure. Deal-specific content lives in facts and records only.
Sector packs add concepts under sec.*; they never change core concepts, and may add vocabulary to core concepts (synonym extensions). A deal activates packs through its deal profile.
Lines are stored; subtotals and ratios are derived by the calculation linkbase. A source's own subtotals, ratios and annual columns are kept as COMPARATIVE facts and tested (R-SRC-01/02/03).
Classification (current or non-current; operating, investing or financing) follows the source's open section; ontology parent links are the default when no section is open.
Period type comes from the months a figure covers, never from a column header; FY, YTD and LTM are derived from months using the deal's fiscal year end.
A company's own EBITDA line is view=MANAGEMENT; REPORTED EBITDA is computed from the deal's EBITDA policy.

period_types.label: Fiscal year
period_types.rule: Sum of 12 fiscal months, or a source that states a full year.

period_types.label: Year to date
period_types.rule: Sum of months from fiscal year start to period_end; months_covered < 12.

period_types.label: Last twelve months
period_types.rule: Sum of the last 12 FM facts ending at period_end. Derived in code.

period_types.label: As at a date
period_types.rule: Balance at a month-end (or stated) date.

period_types.label: Point attribute (no period)
period_types.rule: Terms and parameters such as a rate or a price.

period_policies.ALL_FY_ACTUAL: Every fiscal year in the history window (default: last 3 complete FYs, configurable).
period_policies.YTD_CURRENT: Year to date to the latest actual month.
period_policies.YTD_PRIOR: Same months of the prior fiscal year.
period_policies.LTM_LATEST: LTM to the latest actual month.
period_policies.MONTHLY_LTM: The 12 fiscal months ending at the latest actual month.
period_policies.AS_AT_FY_ENDS: Each fiscal year-end in the window plus the opening balance before the first year.
period_policies.PLAN_YEARS: Every forward plan year in the latest management plan.

concepts.label: Gross revenue (before discounts and returns)
concepts.definition: Invoiced or recognised revenue before sales discounts, returns and allowances.

concepts.label: Revenue
concepts.definition: Net revenue recognised in the period. Equals gross revenue less discounts, and equals the sum of revenue by any complete dimension (service line, segment, site).
concepts.notes: Revenue split lines are NOT separate concepts: they are fin.pl.revenue facts carrying a dimension member (e.g. service_line=<member>).

concepts.label: Other operating income
concepts.definition: Recurring operating income outside core revenue. Classification (operating vs non-operating) follows the deal's EBITDA definition policy.

concepts.label: Cost of sales (total)
concepts.definition: All costs classified above gross profit. Use this node for the TOTAL; product cost alone is fin.pl.cos.goods.

concepts.label: Site occupancy costs in cost of sales
Gross profit
concepts.definition: Revenue less cost of sales.

concepts.label: Operating expenses excluding D&A
concepts.definition: All operating costs below gross profit, excluding depreciation and amortisation. Where the source shows SG&A including depreciation, map that total to fin.pl.opex_incl_da and map depreciation separately.

concepts.label: Operating expenses including D&A (as presented)
concepts.definition: Presentation subtotal some sources use. Equals fin.pl.opex + fin.pl.da when D&A sits inside SG&A.

concepts.label: EBITDA
concepts.definition: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation. ALWAYS carries the dimension view = REPORTED | MANAGEMENT | ADVISER | DILIGENCE | PRO_FORMA. Reported EBITDA follows the deal's EBITDA definition policy (rules R-PL-05).

concepts.label: EBITDAR
concepts.definition: EBITDA plus rent / lease expense (cash or GAAP basis stated in rent_basis attribute).

concepts.label: Right-of-use asset depreciation
synonyms: depreciation of right of use assets

concepts.label: Non-operating income and expense, net
concepts.definition: Net of all items between operating income and profit before tax. Children carry their own sign (income positive, expense negative).

concepts.label: Grant income and amortisation of deferred grant
Preferred dividend accrual booked through P&L
Profit before tax
synonyms: profit on ordinary activities before taxation

concepts.label: Cash and cash equivalents (unrestricted)
synonyms: cash at bank and in hand

concepts.label: Other current assets
synonyms: prepaid expenses and other current assets

concepts.label: PPE at cost
concepts.definition: Gross cost by asset_class. fin.bs.ppe_net = ppe_gross - accumulated_depreciation.

concepts.label: Net current assets
concepts.definition: Current assets less current liabilities (net-asset presentation).

concepts.label: Dividends payable / accrued dividends
concepts.definition: Stock (as-at) concept. Never map to dividends declared or paid (flows).

concepts.label: Borrowings, non-current
synonyms: lines of credit, notes and finance obligation
obligations under finance leases and hire purchase

concepts.label: Operating cash flow
synonyms: net cash generated from operating activities
net cash inflow from operating activities

concepts.label: Other non-cash items
synonyms: gains, d&a and other non-cash items
gain on sale of assets removed

concepts.label: Working-capital movement
concepts.definition: Sum of movements in working-capital lines. Child facts carry dimension wc_line (receivables, inventory, payables ...).
synonyms: change in current assets and liabilities

concepts.label: Other operating cash flows (unclassified)
concepts.definition: Residual for a source line inside the operating section that matches no operating concept. Routed to review; still counted in operating cash flow.

concepts.label: Investing cash flow
synonyms: net cash used in investing activities
net cash from/(used in) investing activities

concepts.label: Capital expenditure (PPE)
concepts.definition: Stored as a positive outflow; weight -1 in investing cash flow.

concepts.label: Financing cash flow
synonyms: net cash used in financing activities
net cash from/(used in) financing activities

concepts.label: Receipts from / payments to related parties
Other investing cash flows (unclassified)
concepts.definition: Residual for an unmatched line inside the investing section.

concepts.label: Other financing cash flows (unclassified)
concepts.definition: Residual for an unmatched line inside the financing section.

concepts.label: Net change in cash
synonyms: net increase/(decrease) in cash and cash equivalents

concepts.label: Operating profit (cash-flow start)
concepts.definition: Start line of an indirect cash flow that begins from operating profit rather than net income. Ties to fin.pl.operating_income (R-CF-06).

concepts.label: Cash at beginning of period
concepts.definition: Cash balance quoted for a flow period: the balance at its start. Aggregates as the first month's value.
synonyms: cash and cash equivalents at beginning of period

concepts.label: Cash at end of period
concepts.definition: Cash balance quoted for a flow period: the balance at its end. Aggregates as the last month's value; ties to fin.bs.cash at the period end (R-CF-03).
synonyms: cash and cash equivalents at end of period

concepts.label: Revenue growth
concepts.definition: Computed in code: revenue[t] / revenue[t-1 comparable] - 1

concepts.label: Revenue CAGR
concepts.definition: Computed in code: (revenue[end]/revenue[start])^(1/years) - 1

concepts.label: Gross margin %
concepts.definition: Computed in code: gross_profit / revenue

concepts.label: EBITDA margin %
concepts.definition: Computed in code: ebitda[view] / revenue

concepts.label: Operating expense ratio
concepts.definition: Computed in code: opex(.line) / revenue

concepts.label: Cost of sales ratio
concepts.definition: Computed in code: cost_of_sales(.line) / revenue

concepts.label: Total labour % of revenue
concepts.definition: Computed in code: (cos.labour + opex.labour + opex.owner_remuneration) / revenue

concepts.label: Trade working capital
concepts.definition: Computed in code: accounts_receivable + inventory - accounts_payable

concepts.label: Operating working capital
concepts.definition: Computed in code: sum(current operating assets) - sum(current operating liabilities); excludes cash, debt, debt-like, dividends payable, related parties
concepts.notes: formula: sum(current operating assets) - sum(current operating liabilities); excludes cash, debt, debt-like, dividends payable, related parties

concepts.label: Average monthly working capital (LTM)
concepts.definition: Computed in code: mean(operating_working_capital at each month-end over 12 months)
concepts.notes: formula: mean(operating_working_capital at each month-end over 12 months)

concepts.label: Receivable days (DSO)
concepts.definition: Computed in code: accounts_receivable[as_at] / revenue[LTM] * 365

concepts.label: Inventory days
concepts.definition: Computed in code: inventory / cost_of_sales.goods[LTM] * 365

concepts.label: Payable days
concepts.definition: Computed in code: accounts_payable / (cost_of_sales + opex)[LTM] * 365

concepts.label: Financial debt
concepts.definition: Computed in code: borrowings_current + borrowings_non_current (+ convertible_notes where debt-like)
concepts.notes: formula: borrowings_current + borrowings_non_current (+ convertible_notes where debt-like)

concepts.label: Net financial debt (net cash if negative)
concepts.definition: Computed in code: financial_debt - cash

concepts.label: Debt-like items (proposed)
concepts.definition: Computed in code: sum(debt_like_item records accepted)

concepts.label: Net debt including debt-like items
concepts.definition: Computed in code: net_financial_debt + debt_like_items

concepts.label: Net debt / EBITDA
concepts.definition: Computed in code: net_financial_debt[as_at] / ebitda[DILIGENCE, LTM]

concepts.label: Free cash flow
concepts.definition: Computed in code: operating_cash_flow - capex

concepts.label: Cash conversion
concepts.definition: Computed in code: operating_cash_flow / ebitda[DILIGENCE]

concepts.label: Capex / depreciation
concepts.definition: Computed in code: capex / da

concepts.label: Capex % of revenue
concepts.definition: Computed in code: capex / revenue

concepts.label: Current ratio
concepts.definition: Computed in code: current_assets / current_liabilities

concepts.label: Rent cover
concepts.definition: Computed in code: ebitdar / rent (rent_basis stated: GAAP, cash or contractual forward)
concepts.notes: formula: ebitdar / rent (rent_basis stated: GAAP, cash or contractual forward)

concepts.label: Fixed-charge cover
concepts.definition: Computed in code: ebitdar / (cash rent + cash interest)

concepts.label: Interest cover
concepts.definition: Computed in code: ebitda / interest_expense

concepts.label: Return on assets
concepts.definition: Computed in code: net_income / average(total_assets)

concepts.label: Revenue per FTE
concepts.definition: Computed in code: revenue / ops.fte

concepts.label: Equity value (equity bridge)
concepts.definition: Computed in code: enterprise_value - net_debt_incl_debt_like +/- working-capital adjustment

concepts.label: EBITDA adjustment amount
concepts.definition: Amount of one QoE adjustment for one period and one view. Details live in the adjustment record (WHY, evidence, tier, treatment). Bridge rule: EBITDA[to_view] = EBITDA[from_view] + sum(adjustments into to_view).

concepts.label: Debt-like item amount
concepts.definition: One fact per debt_like_type member (accrued_dividends, deferred_revenue, capex_payables, customer_deposits, taxes, deferred_consideration, provisions, related_party_balances, grants_repayable). Proposed vs agreed status sits on the record.

concepts.label: Contractual rent for a future year
Seller cost basis by item
concepts.definition: Components of the seller's cost basis (land and building, equipment, fees). Item names are members of the category dimension.

concepts.label: First-year rent under the transaction lease
Active customers / accounts / locations
concepts.definition: Count of active customer units at a date. The unit noun (account, location, subscriber, patient, merchant, home) is stated in the customer_unit attribute.

concepts.label: Logo retention
concepts.definition: Retained customers / opening customers for the period (monthly or annual stated in period_type).

concepts.label: Average revenue per customer unit per month
Total addressable market
concepts.definition: Annual spend pool for the defined market (market_definition record). market_scope distinguishes current vs expanded territory.

concepts.label: Market volume driver (count of buyers, units, households)
Share willing to pay more / WTP
Share preferring a channel or model
Collection or processing cost per ton

calculations.note: Every concept whose stored lines all carry split-dimension members gets an undimensioned total.
Reported EBITDA is always computed from the policy; a company's own EBITDA line is stored as view=MANAGEMENT.
Ratios are recomputed at every period from the period's own sums; they are never summed or averaged.

rules.description: Revenue equals gross revenue less discounts (when both are present).
Gross profit equals revenue less cost of sales.
Operating expenses including D&A equal opex plus D&A (when presented).
Reported EBITDA equals gross profit less opex plus other operating income (policy: include_other_operating_income).
Reported EBITDA equals net income plus tax, less net non-operating items, plus D&A (definitional cross-check).
Operating income equals reported EBITDA less D&A.
Profit before tax equals operating income plus net non-operating items.
Net income equals profit before tax less income tax.
EBITDAR equals EBITDA plus rent for the stated rent basis.
Total assets equal current plus non-current assets.
Total liabilities equal current plus non-current liabilities.
The balance sheet balances.
Net PPE equals cost less accumulated depreciation, per asset class.
Total liabilities and equity equal total assets.
Net change in cash equals operating plus investing plus financing cash flow.
Closing cash equals opening cash plus net change.
Cash-flow closing cash equals balance-sheet cash at the period end (plus restricted cash if the policy includes it).
Opening cash of a period equals closing cash of the previous period.
Cash-flow net income equals P&L net income.
Operating profit starting an indirect cash flow equals operating income in the income statement.
Equity roll-forward closes and ties to the balance sheet.
Dividends payable roll-forward closes and ties to the balance sheet.
Fixed-asset roll-forward closes and ties to net PPE (per asset register).
Facility balances at a date sum to balance-sheet borrowings at the same date.
Per facility, the amortisation-schedule balance equals the ledger balance at the same date. A schedule balance held for a formula error means the facility cannot be verified.
Each EBITDA view equals the view it starts from plus the adjustments into it.
Reported EBITDA in the QoE bridge equals reported EBITDA in the income statement.
Members of a complete dimension sum to the undimensioned total (revenue by service line, segment, site).
Fiscal-year, quarter and YTD flows equal the sum of their months.
A duration fact with months_covered < 12 can never carry period_type FY.
Instant facts are dated at a period end (month-end unless the source states a date).
ACTUAL facts end on or before the latest actual month; plan-basis facts may not sit in history views.
A source subtotal written as a SUM over a row range equals the sum of the extracted lines in that range, and every line in the range is mapped (nothing dropped).

Each subtotal or ratio derived in code equals the source's own figure for the same concept, period and view. A difference is explained by composition (the source range holds concepts outside the canonical subtotal) or flagged.
A source annual column equals the FY or YTD derived from the months it covers. Its period type comes from the months covered, never from the column header.
Every subtotal equals the weighted sum of its child concepts when all children (or an unclassified residual) are present.
ARR equals MRR times 12 at the same date.
Logo churn equals one minus logo retention.
Gross revenue retention never exceeds net revenue retention or 100%.
Top-N concentration is between 0 and 100% and rises with N.
Customer count rolls forward with new and churned customers (allowing reactivations as a stated residual).
TAM is at least SAM, and SAM is at least SOM, for the same scope, segment, geography and year.
SOM is at least the company's own revenue for the same segment, geography and year; otherwise flag the definition.
A bottom-up market equals volume driver times price driver times participation (as recorded in market_build_step).
Percentages lie within the plausible range for their concept.
Retention, NRR and growth may exceed 100% but stay below 500%.
Counts are non-negative.
Days lie between 0 and 730.
Currency facts lie within 0.001x to 1,000x of the company's revenue scale.
Margins lie between -100% and 100%.

reason_codes.meaning: Two sources of equal authority disagree beyond tolerance
A calculation or identity rule failed; rule id in reason_detail
Label period and header period disagree
Unit or scale could not be determined
Line could not be placed under any parent node
Document type routed to another module
A newer version of the document exists
Document is not part of the deal's data room
Source cell holds a spreadsheet error value (a broken reference or a failed lookup)
The source shows text or nothing where a value should be (for example 'needs data')
Value was found inside a label (ID, code, account number)
Merged into an existing fact with the same key
Kept as comparative; a higher-authority source was selected
Excluded by a reviewer, reason recorded
Plan and actual cannot be compared
Source subtotal kept as a check; the canonical subtotal is derived from lines in code
Ratio or derived metric recomputed by the calculation engine; the source value is kept as a check
